text.en:
Major George F. Downey, paymaster, United States Army, acting as city treasurer and disbursing
officer under the Provost-Marshal-General of the city of Manila, is hereby authorized to close up the
business of his Department for July, nineteen hundred and one, and for the days from August first to August
sixth inclusive, nineteen hundred and one, and for that purpose is authorized to draw warrants to pay the
obligations of the government of Manila under the Provost-Marshal-General, and to do all the other acts
necessary for the settling of the financial affairs of the city of Manila clown to and including August sixth,
nineteen hundred and one.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 16, 1901.
